TD-46: Optional TS hardening (`noUncheckedIndexedAccess` first); bring `scripts/smoke.mjs` inside type checking or accept the gap explicitly

TD-45: Adopt one dependency-pinning policy (exact pins + lockfile with a deliberate update cadence) and apply it uniformly; track `tiptap-markdown@0.9.0` pre-1.0 + local type shim as a named risk; note `lucide-react@1.70.0` is verified real, not a typo

TD-42: Key seeding on a dedicated marker (starter folder ids or a settings row) or document the "any folder exists" heuristic
TD-41: Vision path: check the selected model is vision-capable (Ollama `/api/show`) and validate the image payload before forwarding; fail fast with the existing friendly message

TD-40: Assistant path efficiency/correctness: cache runtime status server-side for a few seconds; set the chat fetch timeout below `maxDuration` (e.g. 75 s vs 90 s); split status codes by fault (400 client / 502–503 upstream)
TD-39: Record the prompt-injection posture honestly: system-prompt sentence is a mitigation, not a defence; revisit with delimiting/output validation if the model path gains tools or autonomy

TD-38: Improve built-in heuristics: abbreviation/decimal-aware sentence tokeniser; truncate summaries on a sentence/word boundary; vary or drop Expand boilerplate for non-prose; fix Explain on empty text ("0 words across 1 sentence")
TD-37: Unify the workspace read path: `GET /api/notes` shares `getWorkspace()` (one ordering, one seeding site); document the full-dump-by-design contract
TD-35: Add CI (GitHub Actions: `npm ci`, typecheck, lint, build with dummy/lazy DB config, plus a Postgres service job running smoke) and a minimal deployment story

TD-34: Make smoke runnable: add `"smoke": "node scripts/smoke.mjs"`, document/install the Playwright browser, and provide a one-command harness (Postgres + schema push + server + health wait + smoke + teardown)
TD-33: Add a unit-test runner (Vitest or `node --test`) with tests for `assistant.ts` built-in tools and `workspace.ts` helpers; add a `test` script
TD-32: Fix model-selection UI consistency (Settings select value vs tools mode; dock menu check marks); make voice language a setting or document the `en-US` lock
TD-31: Add ARIA wiring to Search selection (`role="combobox"`/`listbox`/`option`, `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-selected`)
TD-30: Print: switch out of Markdown source mode before `window.print()` (or add an intentional print rule for source mode); document replacement-only suggestion printing
TD-29: Gate global shortcuts when a dialog is open or the target is a form field; add Escape handling to popovers
TD-28: CapturePreview: reset `ready`/`error` on `kind` change; friendly error copy when `getDisplayMedia` is missing
TD-27: Decide and document `plainText` suggestion semantics (index original vs replacement consistently across count/search/export); note the hand-authored-markup limitation
TD-26: `exportNote`: read from `notesRef.current` after flushing (as `exportWorkspace` does); sanitise the download filename
TD-25: Wire `resolveAll` to bulk accept/reject buttons in the suggestion chip/menu, or delete it
TD-24: Hide/disable suggestion Accept/Reject when `!editor.isEditable`; add a runtime test for Reading mode and trashed notes
TD-23: Debounce localStorage cache writes (1–2 s + `visibilitychange`/`beforeunload`) and/or persist only dirty notes; surface quota failure
TD-22: Derive the outline from the editor document (or a real Markdown parse) and scroll by heading anchor, not positional DOM index

TD-21: Voice: treat `no-speech`/`aborted` as restartable in continuous mode (clear `keepListening` only on `not-allowed`/`audio-capture`); detach/ignore `onresult` on stop-from-submit (generation counter or `abort()`)
TD-18: Preserve formatting on suggestions: store the original as a ProseMirror JSON fragment/slice and restore it on reject; refuse or specially handle multi-block selections
TD-17: Fix the Work-workspace filter: compute descendant folder ids of the workspace root and test membership

TD-16: Make the DB pool lazy (no import-time throw), configure `max`/timeouts/`error` handler, cache the pool on `globalThis` unconditionally; let `/api/health` report `{ok:false}` instead of failing to load
TD-15: Fix `cleanText`: case-preserving a→an replacement; re-collapse whitespace after the fallback pass; reconsider/document intensifier stripping as a meaning change

TD-14: Parse request bodies defensively in all mutating routes (object check → 400 with existing friendly copy); stop returning raw `error.message` from the assistant route; notes POST nonexistent-folder 404 → 400/422

TD-13: Decide version history's home: persist server-side (`note_versions` written by PATCH) **or** document plainly (README + Settings) that it is browser-local and excluded from exports; warn on quota failure
TD-12: Complete the folder model: `parentId` FK + existence validation; PATCH/DELETE folder endpoints; rename/delete UI (notes unfile on delete); new folders default to the current context

TD-11: Validate `folderId` in PATCH with a truthful 400; fix the misleading "saved on device / reconnect" 500 copy; add an exponential-backoff retry timer while saves are pending and surface the pending count
TD-10: Add request-size limits: early `Content-Length` rejection on mutating routes; cap note `content` at insert/update to a stated maximum

TD-9: Fix built-in `ask` intents: test the user's `instruction` (not the document) for word-count/title; count the correct text per context mode; derive titles from the document or drop the "inspired by your opening" claim
TD-8: Treat an empty Ollama response as an error for every action except `remove`
TD-7: Built-in Tighten: return the already-concise fallback with `edit: false` (chat response, not a replacement)
TD-6: Generate and commit Drizzle migrations; switch README beyond first setup to `migrate`; resolve the `drizzle/` gitignore ambiguity by tracking it

TD-5: Make `drizzle.config` env-driven (TS config reading `DATABASE_URL`); remove the committed credential URL; replace example password `scribe` with an obvious placeholder and confirm it is used nowhere real
TD-4: Split note creation/update: PATCH becomes true update (404 on missing), creation only via POST; validate `folderId` on PATCH as POST does; delete the dead 404 or make it real

TD-3: Enforce the trust boundary: loopback/`Host`/`Origin` enforcement or per-install token middleware; validate `Content-Type` + same-origin on mutations; stop disclosing Ollama endpoint/inventory unauthenticated
TD-2: Serialise saves per note (promise chain) or add revision/CAS so stale PATCHes cannot regress the DB; only the latest revision may set "saved"
TD-1: Reconcile boot cache with server: SSR props authoritative, merge per-note by `updatedAt`, drop cached ids absent server-side unless flagged unsynced
